newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Alcatel, Fujitsu win Manila deal.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel, Fujitsu win Manila deal.

text.p: A consortium of Philippine companies said on Monday it has awarded a $112 million project to set up a national telecommunications backbone to Fujitsu Ltd of Japan and the local unit of engineering giant Alcatel Alsthom.
Fujitsu and Alcatel Philippines Inc "provided the most technically efficient and reliable as well as lowest bid," consortium president Primitivo Penaranda told Reuters.

Other companies who bid for the project included Siemens AG , NEC Corp of Japan, Ericsson Telecommunications Inc of Sweden, AT&T Submarine Systems Inc, Nortel Telecom (Asia) Ltd, NERA Telecommunications/NERA SEA Pte Ltd of Singapore, and Pirelli.
The local consortium is called Telecom Infrastructure Corp of the Philippines and is made up of all local telecom companies except dominant carrier Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co .

These companies include ICC Telecoms, Globe Telecom , Digital Telecommunications Philippines Inc, Philippine Global Communications, Philippine Telephone & Telegraph Corp, Smart Communications Co Inc, Express Telecommunications Philippines Inc, Eastern Telecommunications Philippines Inc and Pilipino Telephone Corp.
